verdict.rationale: Abacum is an AI-native FP&A platform, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack covers model-training data use, opt-outs, or data-usage commitments. The security page covers only role-based permissions and edit history, which are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
